about: The graduale of the formulary “Septuagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: You are a helper in due season, in tribulation; let those who know You hope in You, for You do not forsake those who seek You, O Lord. For the poor man will not be forgotten forever, nor will the patience of the poor ever perish; arise, O Lord, let no man prevail.

a.g: let those who know You hope in You
the poor man will not be forgotten forever
